group.passage:
Most libraries lend out books, but a Human Library lends out people. The idea was born in Denmark in 2000, when a group of young people set up the first one at a music festival. Since then, it [[1]] more than eighty countries around the world.
In a Human Library, each “book” is a volunteer with a life story to share. Many of them belong to groups that often [[2]] prejudice, such as refugees, people who are deaf, and people with lots of tattoos. A reader chooses a title and borrows the “book” for about thirty minutes. During that time, the reader can ask any question, as long as he or she is [[3]].
The main goal of the Human Library is to [[4]] people to talk with someone they might never meet in daily life. Many readers say that a single conversation changed the way they see others. [[5]], a student who once knew little about refugees may leave the library with a new friend and a better understanding of their lives. As the project’s motto says, “Don’t judge a book by its cover.”

1.explanation_zh: Since then（從那時起到現在）要搭配現在完成式 have／has＋過去分詞，表示從 2000 年到現在，這個點子已經「傳到」八十多個國家：has reached。
evidence: Since then, it [[1]] more than eighty countries around the world.
The idea was born in Denmark in 2000, when a group of young people set up the first one at a music festival.

option_notes_zh.A: was reaching：過去進行式表示過去某個時候正在進行，不能搭配 since then 表示「一直到現在」。
option_notes_zh.B: will reach：未來式不能搭配 since then（從過去某時到現在）。
option_notes_zh.D: is reaching：現在進行式表示此刻正在進行，不能搭配 since then 表示「到現在為止的結果」。

1.strategy_zh: 看到 since＋過去時間點或 since then，先想到現在完成式。
hints: 空格要填動詞時態，主詞 it 指這個點子。
句首 Since then＝從 2000 年那時起到現在。
到現在為止的結果用現在完成式：has reached。

2.explanation_zh: face prejudice 是「面對、遭受偏見」的搭配。這些志工屬於常被別人帶著成見看待的群體，例如難民、聽障者、身上有很多刺青的人。face（面對、遭遇）。
evidence: Many of them belong to groups that often [[2]] prejudice, such as refugees, people who are deaf, and people with lots of tattoos.

option_notes_zh.A: enjoy（享受）：沒有人會「享受」偏見，和 prejudice 的負面意思矛盾。
option_notes_zh.B: hide（隱藏）：「常常隱藏偏見的群體，例如難民、聽障者」說不通；舉例的這些人是被別人用偏見看待的一方。
option_notes_zh.C: count（數、計算）：偏見不能「數」，說不通。

2.strategy_zh: prejudice（偏見）是負面的遭遇，搭配「面對、遭受」的動詞 face。
hints: 空格要填動詞，受詞是 prejudice（偏見）。
such as 後面舉的難民、聽障者、有刺青的人，常被別人用成見看待。

3.explanation_zh: as long as 表示「只要」：讀者可以問任何問題，只要有「禮貌」就好。這是真人圖書館的規則：問什麼都可以，但要尊重對方。
evidence: During that time, the reader can ask any question, as long as he or she is [[3]].

option_notes_zh.B: late（遲到的）：「只要遲到就可以問任何問題」不合理，遲到不會是發問的條件。
option_notes_zh.C: asleep（睡著的）：睡著了就不能發問，說不通。
option_notes_zh.D: quiet（安靜的）：問問題要開口說話，「只要保持安靜就能問任何問題」前後矛盾。

3.strategy_zh: as long as 後面是條件：在什麼條件下可以問任何問題？
hints: 空格要填形容詞，句型是 as long as＋主詞＋be＋adj.。
讀者可以問任何問題，但要符合一個條件。

4.explanation_zh: encourage＋人＋to V 是「鼓勵某人做某事」。真人圖書館的目的是鼓勵人們和平常不會遇到的人交談；下一句也說很多讀者因為一次談話就改變了看別人的方式。
evidence: The main goal of the Human Library is to [[4]] people to talk with someone they might never meet in daily life.
Many readers say that a single conversation changed the way they see others.

option_notes_zh.A: forbid（禁止）：只讀本句說得通（目的是禁止人們和陌生人交談），但前一段說讀者借「書」就是為了和他談三十分鐘，下一句 Many readers say that a single conversation changed the way they see others. 也說談話帶來改變，所以不是禁止。
option_notes_zh.C: order（命令）：只讀本句也說得通，但前一段 A reader chooses a title and borrows the “book” for about thirty minutes. 說讀者是自己挑書來借，不是被命令去談話。
option_notes_zh.D: repeat（重複）：repeat 不能接「人＋to V」，「重複人們去交談」說不通。

4.strategy_zh: 從活動的作法（讀者自己選書來談）和下一句的心得，判斷目的是「鼓勵」交談。
hints: 空格要填動詞，句型是 V＋人＋to V。
讀者自己選書；下一句說一次談話就改變了他們的看法。
目的是「鼓勵」人們和不認識的人交談：encourage。

5.explanation_zh: 前一句說很多讀者表示一次談話就改變了他們看別人的方式；本句舉出具體的例子：原本不太了解難民的學生，離開時可能多了一位新朋友。所以用 For example（例如）。
evidence: Many readers say that a single conversation changed the way they see others.
[[5]], a student who once knew little about refugees may leave the library with a new friend and a better understanding of their lives.

option_notes_zh.A: Even so（即使如此）：表示讓步，但後句不是和前句相反的情況，而是前句的例子。
option_notes_zh.B: As usual（和往常一樣）：本句是在舉例，不是說「照慣例」，說不通。
option_notes_zh.C: Until now（直到現在）：表示時間，後句用的是 may leave（可能會離開），和「直到現在」不合。

5.strategy_zh: 前句是概括的說法，後句是具體的人和事：用表示舉例的轉承語。
hints: 空格要填轉承語，連接前後兩句。
前句：很多讀者說一次談話改變了看法；後句：一位學生的具體情形。
後句是前句的例子：For example。

translation_zh.text:
大多數圖書館借出的是書，真人圖書館借出的卻是人。這個點子在 2000 年誕生於丹麥，當時一群年輕人在一場音樂節上辦了第一場活動。從那時起，它已經傳到世界上八十多個國家。
在真人圖書館裡，每一本「書」都是一位有人生故事可以分享的志工。他們很多人屬於常遭受偏見的群體，例如難民、聽障者，以及身上有很多刺青的人。讀者選好一個書名，就能把這本「書」借出來大約三十分鐘。在這段時間裡，讀者可以問任何問題，只要有禮貌就好。
真人圖書館的主要目的，是鼓勵人們和日常生活中可能永遠不會遇到的人交談。許多讀者說，一次談話就改變了他們看待別人的方式。例如，一個原本對難民所知不多的學生，離開圖書館時可能多了一位新朋友，也更了解他們的生活。就像這個計畫的標語說的：「不要以封面評斷一本書。」

evidence: Since then, it [[1]] more than eighty countries around the world.
1.explanation_zh: Since then 表示從過去持續到現在，須用現在完成式 has reached。

evidence: Many of them belong to groups that often [[2]] prejudice, such as refugees, people who are deaf, and people with lots of tattoos.
2.explanation_zh: 難民、聽障者、刺青者等族群常「面對」偏見，face prejudice 為常見搭配。

evidence: During that time, the reader can ask any question, as long as he or she is [[3]].
3.explanation_zh: 讀者可以問任何問題，條件是要「有禮貌」(polite)；quiet 與提問矛盾。

evidence: The main goal of the Human Library is to [[4]] people to talk with someone they might never meet in daily life.
4.explanation_zh: 真人圖書館的目的在「鼓勵」人們與平常不會遇到的人交談；encourage sb to V。

evidence: Many readers say that a single conversation changed the way they see others.
[[5]], a student who once knew little about refugees may leave the library with a new friend and a better understanding of their lives.
5.explanation_zh: 後句是一個具體例子，說明一次對話如何改變人的看法，故用 For example。

evidence: Since then, it [[1]] more than eighty countries around the world.
1.explanation_zh: Since then 表示從過去到現在的持續結果，需用現在完成式 has reached。

evidence: Many of them belong to groups that often [[2]] prejudice, such as refugees, people who are deaf, and people with lots of tattoos.
2.explanation_zh: 難民、聽障者、有大量刺青的人是常「面對」偏見的族群，face prejudice 為常見搭配。

evidence: During that time, the reader can ask any question, as long as he or she is [[3]].
3.explanation_zh: 可以問任何問題，只要「有禮貌」（polite）；late、asleep、quiet 都無法作為提問的條件。

evidence: The main goal of the Human Library is to [[4]] people to talk with someone they might never meet in daily life.
4.explanation_zh: encourage sb to V 為「鼓勵某人做某事」，符合真人圖書館的目標。

evidence: Many readers say that a single conversation changed the way they see others.
[[5]], a student who once knew little about refugees may leave the library with a new friend and a better understanding of their lives.
5.explanation_zh: 空格後舉出學生認識難民的具體例子來說明前句，故用 For example。

A.evidence: Since then, it [[1]] more than eighty countries around the world.
A.explanation_zh: was reaching（過去進行式）不能搭配 Since then 表示「從過去某時一直到現在」。

B.evidence: Since then, it [[1]] more than eighty countries around the world.
B.explanation_zh: will reach（未來式）不能搭配 Since then；從 2000 年到現在要用現在完成式。

D.evidence: Since then, it [[1]] more than eighty countries around the world.
D.explanation_zh: is reaching（現在進行式）不能搭配 Since then 表示到現在為止的累積結果。

A.evidence: Many of them belong to groups that often [[2]] prejudice, such as refugees, people who are deaf, and people with lots of tattoos.
A.explanation_zh: enjoy（享受）：偏見是負面的，沒有群體會享受偏見；舉例的難民、聽障者是承受偏見的一方。

B.evidence: Many of them belong to groups that often [[2]] prejudice, such as refugees, people who are deaf, and people with lots of tattoos.
B.explanation_zh: hide（隱藏）：「常常隱藏偏見的群體」指他們自己懷有偏見，和舉例的難民、聽障者常被別人帶偏見看待的文意相反；末句 Don’t judge a book by its cover 也指他們是被評斷的一方。

C.evidence: Many of them belong to groups that often [[2]] prejudice, such as refugees, people who are deaf, and people with lots of tattoos.
C.explanation_zh: count（數）：偏見不能被數，count prejudice 不成搭配。

B.evidence: During that time, the reader can ask any question, as long as he or she is [[3]].
B.explanation_zh: late（遲到的）：遲到不可能是「可以問任何問題」的條件。

C.evidence: During that time, the reader can ask any question, as long as he or she is [[3]].
C.explanation_zh: asleep（睡著的）：睡著就不能發問，條件和結果矛盾。

D.evidence: During that time, the reader can ask any question, as long as he or she is [[3]].
D.explanation_zh: quiet（安靜的）：發問就要開口說話，「只要保持安靜就能問任何問題」自相矛盾；後文也說目的是和人交談（talk with someone），第一場還辦在音樂節（at a music festival），安靜不是這裡的條件。「可以問任何問題」要限制的是發問的態度，所以是有禮貌。

A.evidence: Many readers say that a single conversation changed the way they see others.
A.explanation_zh: forbid（禁止）：讀者借「書」就是為了和他交談，下一句也說一次談話帶來改變，目標不可能是禁止人們交談。

C.evidence: A reader chooses a title and borrows the “book” for about thirty minutes.
C.explanation_zh: order（命令）：讀者是自己挑書來借，交談出於自願；圖書館的「主要目標」是命令人們交談不合文意，語氣也和全文推廣理解的精神不符。

D.evidence: The main goal of the Human Library is to [[4]] people to talk with someone they might never meet in daily life.
D.explanation_zh: repeat 不能用「repeat＋人＋to V」的句型，「重複人們去交談」不成句。

A.evidence: Many readers say that a single conversation changed the way they see others.
A.explanation_zh: Even so（即使如此）表示讓步轉折，但後句是前句「一次談話改變看法」的具體例子，不是相反的情況。

B.evidence: Many readers say that a single conversation changed the way they see others.
B.explanation_zh: As usual（和往常一樣）：後句是在舉一個學生的例子說明前句，不是描述慣常情況；may leave 也是可能發生的例子。

C.evidence: [[5]], a student who once knew little about refugees may leave the library with a new friend and a better understanding of their lives.
C.explanation_zh: Until now（直到現在）表示時間，和本句 may leave 的推測語氣不合，也無法銜接前句。
